      Parameters:
      name - falls back to "Unknown" if null/blank

      bounty - falls back to 0 if negative

    • assignCrew

      public boolean assignCrew(PirateCrew pirateCrew)
      Purpose: Links this pirate to a crew. Contract: only PirateCrew.recruitMember should call this, so the two-way link stays consistent.
      Parameters:
      pirateCrew - rejected if null or if this pirate is already affiliated
      Returns:
      true if the link was set, false otherwise

    • toggleCaptain

      public boolean toggleCaptain(boolean state)
      Purpose: Promotes or demotes this pirate as captain of their crew.
      Parameters:
      state - true to become captain, false to step down
      Returns:
      true if the toggle applied, false if this pirate has no crew
